info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Basaltic Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Basaltic Drill Detail API enables users to create and manage detailed records of basaltic drill products in the catalog. This service supports the addition of specifications, features, and other relevant data for each drill item. It's particularly useful for manufacturers, product managers, and inventory systems looking to maintain an up-to-date catalog of drilling equipment. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their product offerings and enhance customer access to accurate and comprehensive product information.

post.summary: Create or update details for a basaltic drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create or update details associated with a basaltic drill. It handles the submission of relevant information and ensures that it is stored or modified accordingly, facilitating better management of drill data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details for basaltic drill operations. It includes structured data necessary for the operation to proceed. Please ensure that the payload conforms to the defined schema to avoid errors during processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning drill details.

CreateCatalogBasalticDrillDetailRequest.title: Basaltic Drill Operation Request

basaltic_drill_id.description: Unique identifier for the basaltic drill.

requestedBy.description: Name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: Number of basaltic drills requested for the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the basaltic drill.

tags.description: Tags associated with the operation request.

items.description: A tag that categorizes the operation.

CreateCatalogBasalticDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing a request body for initiating a basaltic drill operation.

CreateCatalogBasalticDrillDetailResponse.title: Basaltic Drill Operations Response

status.description: Status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the record associated with the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: Number of records that matched the operation criteria.

warnings.description: List of warnings encountered during the operation.
example: Some records were not processed due to missing fields.

items.description: A warning message related to the operation.
items.example: Some records were not processed due to missing fields.

CreateCatalogBasalticDrillDetailResponse.description: This schema represents the response for the Basaltic Drill operations POST request. It provides information regarding the operation status, the unique record ID, the processing timestamp, matched records count, and any warnings encountered during the operation.

warnings: Some records were not processed due to missing fields.
